description:
Because:
- The epic that moves fxa-shared folders to Nx libs needs express in its own lib.
- The fxa-content-server Node server must keep working through the fxa-shared paths.

This commit:
- Adds the lib libs/shared/express and the @fxa/shared/express path.
- Moves cors, geo-locate, remote-address and routing into the lib.
- Changes the fxa-shared express files to one-line re-exports.
- Ports the mocha tests to Jest specs in the lib and adds a shim spec.
- Adds celebrate, cors, joi and @types/cors to the root package.json.

Closes FXA-10658
